notes.title: The English version is online today!
notes.content:
At present, all the dialogues and interfaces are in English.
But I can't see the relevant information. I don't know if it's because I'm in China (I only show Chinese here).
So if a foreign friend buys a game, you can see if there is an English version that can be updated or downloaded. If you have any suggestions, please leave a message to me. Thank you.

notes.title: MissCat上线了~ MissCat is online~
notes.content:
很激动自己做的独立游戏上线了╭(●｀∀´●)╯，希望玩家们多提宝贵意见，同时英文版正在制作中~
I'm very excited that the independent game I've made is online. I hope that the players will give more valuable comments. At the same time, the English version is being produced~
